summary: 植物可借刺毛、黏液或刺激性物质阻止动物取食，也能释放物质影响邻近植物的生长。文章重点解释后一种“化感作用”，并讨论将其用于作物抑草与天然除草剂的可能。

paragraphs.brief: 卷叶与茸毛的防护作用
sentences: The general perception of plants is that they are defenceless when faced with threat from animals (including man), insects and other plants.
对植物的一般看法是，当它们面临动物(包括人)、昆虫和其他植物的威胁时，它们没有自卫能力。
This, however, is not the case.
然而，情况并非如此。
Plants are able to defend themselves against attack from their environment in many ways.
植物能够在许多方面保护自己免受环境攻击。
There are two major features of plants that ensure their continuation as species.
植物有两个主要特征可以确保它们作为物种的延续。
One of these relates to their physical attributes.
其中一种防御方式与植物的外形结构有关。
Spinifex grass, a plant native to Australia, provides a notable example.
澳大利亚原生的滨刺草便是一个例子。
Adapted to life in the hot, desert inland, spinifex has developed tightly rolled leaves which reduce the effects of drought stress.
为了适应内陆炎热荒漠，滨刺草长出紧紧卷起的叶片，以减轻干旱带来的压力。
The hairs, or trichomes, which are found on the inner surface of the rolled-up spinifex leaf are believed to assist in minimising water loss.
卷叶内表面的茸毛被认为有助于减少水分流失。
Trichomes also have defensive roles against predators.
茸毛也能帮助植物防御啃食它们的动物。
Many plants, such as the sunflower, have hairy leaves which are rough to the touch.
许多植物都有摸起来粗糙的毛叶，例如向日葵。
When the plant is bitten by a grazing animal, the sensation is unpleasant on the tongue and the animal normally moves on to find more palatable food.
食草动物咬下去时舌头会感到不适，通常就会转去寻找更可口的植物。
paragraphs.gist: 植物可以靠叶片结构自保，例如卷曲的澳洲滨刺草叶片及茸毛有助于减少失水，向日葵叶片的粗毛则让食草动物不愿再吃。

paragraphs.brief: 储毒、黏附和刺人的腺毛
sentences: Some families of plants such as the Solanaceae, which includes the tomato, the potato and other food plants, feature glandular trichomes.
有些植物科具有腺毛，例如包括番茄、马铃薯及其他食用植物的茄科。
In these structures a tiny sac is carried on the hair, which rises from the epidermis, or skin, of the plant.
这些毛状结构由植物表皮长出，顶着一个小囊。
The sac contains chemicals which may perform a range of functions.
小囊内的化学物质可发挥多种作用。
For example, an insect landing on a tomato leaf and rupturing the sac is exposed to a toxic chemical which will deter it from feeding on that plant in future.
例如，昆虫落在番茄叶上碰破小囊，就会接触到有毒物质，以后便不愿再取食这株植物。
In other plants of the same family, the sacs contain a natural adhesive and the unsuspecting insect landing on such a leaf and rupturing a trichome sac is held onto the plant, unable to depart.
同科其他植物的小囊中存有天然黏胶，昆虫不知情地落在叶上碰破小囊，就被黏住而无法脱身。
In the leaves of the nettle plant these trichomes resemble miniature hypodermic syringes.
荨麻叶上的这些毛状结构则很像微型皮下注射器。
An irritant chemical is stored at the base of the ‘syringe’.
刺激性化学物质储存在这个“注射器”的底部。
If an animal touches it, a shot of the chemical is discharged through the ‘needle’ and into the skin of the animal.
动物一旦碰触，化学物质就会从“针尖”射入皮肤。
The irritation the chemical causes is a deterrent against future threat.
由此产生的不适可以阻止动物再次靠近。
paragraphs.gist: 腺毛能储存化学物质，番茄等植物以毒素或黏胶对付昆虫，而荨麻的刺毛碰到动物皮肤时会注入刺激物。

paragraphs.brief: 桉树对邻近植物的化感作用
sentences: The poisons and glues of the Solanaceae and the irritant of the nettle indicate the other major method of plant survival: that some plants use chemicals to protect themselves, sometimes from each other.
茄科植物的毒素和黏胶，以及荨麻的刺激物，体现了另一种生存方式，即利用化学物质自我保护，有时甚至用来防御其他植物。
Chemical interactions that occur between plants are known as ‘allelopathy’, and in natural plant communities it is one of many factors which determine how plants grow in relation to one another.
植物之间的化学相互作用称为化感作用，也是自然植物群落中决定相邻植物如何生长的因素之一。
An example in Australia is the suppression of vegetation growth beneath eucalypt trees, an effect which decreases with increasing distance from the trunk of the tree.
澳大利亚的桉树会抑制树下植被生长，而且距离树干越远，这种抑制作用越弱。
paragraphs.gist: 植物还能释放化学物质影响其他植物，这称为化感作用，例如桉树附近的植被受抑制，离树干越远影响越弱。

paragraphs.brief: 曼陀罗萌发时压制竞争者
sentences: The most detailed studies of allelopathy have generally been carried out on agricultural plant communities.
对化感作用最细致的研究通常是在农业植物群落中进行的。
In agriculture, allelopathy has been identified particularly with weeds, which compete with desired crop or pasture species, such as wheat, oats and grass, for environmental resources.
农业中尤以杂草的化感作用受到关注，它们会与小麦、燕麦和牧草等人们需要的植物争夺环境资源。
Competition can be physical, where the growth of one plant maximises the use of water, nutrients and light to the disadvantage of another.
竞争可以通过直接占据水、养分和阳光来进行，一株植物利用得越充分，另一株便越不利。
Allelopathy, on the other hand, involves plant-produced chemicals which may poison a neighbouring plant.
化感作用则涉及植物产生的化学物质，这些物质可能毒害邻近植物。
On the whole, weeds are far more physically and chemically aggressive than crop and pasture species.
总体而言，杂草争夺资源以及通过化学物质压制邻近植物的能力，都远强于作物和牧草。

As an example, recent research on the common thorn apple, Datura stramonium, a weed found throughout Australia, has found that two powerful chemicals are released from the seed during the early stages of germination.
以澳大利亚各地常见的杂草曼陀罗为例，研究发现其种子在萌发早期会释放两种作用很强的化合物。
In fact, it is necessary for the chemicals to be released from the seed coat so that the seed can germinate.
种皮必须释放这些物质，种子才能萌发。
Once released, the chemicals then provide a barrier that inhibits the growth of any potential plant competitor near the thorn apple seedling.
释放后，这些物质会形成一道屏障，抑制曼陀罗幼苗附近潜在竞争植物的生长。
paragraphs.gist: 杂草除了争夺水、光和养分，还能通过化学物质排挤竞争者，例如曼陀罗萌发时释放的物质会抑制附近幼苗。

paragraphs.brief: 化感物质如何选择性起效
sentences: Allelopathic chemicals function in quite subtle ways.
化感物质发挥作用的方式十分微妙。
Generally they are active in small quantities, they are effective only with certain other plants, they act by disrupting the plant’s natural processes and they have no known residual effects.
它们通常在微量下就有活性，只对某些植物有效，通过干扰目标植物的自然生理过程发挥作用，目前没有发现残留效应。

It has also been found that the activity of these chemicals may be synergistic, that is, two or more such substances may combine to produce an effect that is greater than the effects of the substances acting in isolation.
研究还发现，多种化感物质可能产生协同作用，两种或更多物质联用的效果会超过各自单独作用。
These are the very attributes which are being targeted in the current development of synthetic herbicides*.
这些特性正是当前研制合成除草剂时希望达到的。

Allelopathy is not restricted to weeds in agriculture, but allelopathic activity in crop and pasture plants appears to have diminished, possibly because plant breeders may have concentrated on improving aspects of crop quality and quantity rather than aspects of defence against natural enemies.
化感作用并非农田杂草特有，但栽培作物和牧草的化感活性似乎有所减弱，可能因为育种者更重视提高产量和品质，而较少选育抵御天敌的能力。
paragraphs.gist: 化感物质用量少、作用对象特定，还可能相互增强效果，栽培作物的这项防御能力则可能因育种偏重产量和品质而减弱。

paragraphs.brief: 天然除草的成本与环境效益
sentences: Allelopathic chemicals may be harvested for development as ‘natural herbicides’, similar to the harvest of pyrethrins from the pyrethrum daisy for use as natural insecticides.
化感物质可提取出来开发成天然除草剂，类似于从除虫菊中提取天然杀虫剂除虫菊素。
Harnessing allelopathy is highly attractive to the farming industry, as at least half of the more than A$200-million annual cost of crop protection in Australia is spent on herbicides.
澳大利亚每年用于农作物保护的开支超过 2 亿澳元，其中至少一半花在除草剂上。因此，利用植物的化感作用对农业界很有吸引力。
Enhancing allelopathic activity in crop and pasture plants could reduce this enormous bill.
若能增强作物和牧草的化感活性，这笔巨额开支就可能降低。
Developing and harvesting natural herbicides might also offer real advantages in addressing environmental concerns about the over-use of synthetic chemicals currently used in crop protection.
开发和提取天然除草剂，还有助于应对作物保护中过量使用合成化学品所带来的环境问题。

In many parts of the world, communities are showing an increased willingness to pay a premium for products grown with few or no synthetic chemicals, and natural products are becoming increasingly attractive.
在世界许多地方，人们越来越愿意为少用或不用合成化学品种出的产品多付些钱，天然产品也愈发受到青睐。
paragraphs.gist: 若能提取天然除草成分或增强作物本身的化感作用，农户有望减少除草开支，同时满足消费者对少用合成化学品的需求。

items.en: an example of a plant’s use of chemicals in its reproductive process
items.zh: 植物在繁殖过程中利用化学物质的一个例子。
items.why: 题干关键词是 reproductive process,这里对应 germination 发芽，属于植物繁殖/生长初期过程。use of chemicals 对应 two powerful chemicals are released。

items.en: how some plants use a kind of glue to discourage attack
items.zh: 有些植物如何用胶水阻止攻击
items.why: 题干中的 a kind of glue 对应原文 a natural adhesive。discourage attack 对应昆虫被黏住后无法继续取食或攻击。

items.en: two examples of non-chemical methods of defence in plants
items.zh: 植物依靠非化学手段进行防御的两个例子。
items.why: 题干重点是 non-chemical methods,即非化学方法。第A段讲的是 physical attributes 物理特征，包括卷叶减少干旱压力、毛状叶片让动物口感不适，属于两个物理防御例子。

items.en: a definition of the term allelopathy
items.zh: 对植物“化感作用”这一术语的定义。
items.why: 这是非常直接的定义句。题干中的 definition of the term allelopathy 对应原文 are known as 'allelopathy'。

items.en: descriptions of how plants use chemicals to discourage predators
items.zh: 说明植物如何使用化学品来阻止捕食者
items.why: 第B段集中描述植物用 toxic chemical 有毒化学物质和 irritant chemical 刺激性化学物质来对付昆虫或动物，因此对应“用化学物质阻止 Re’.

items.en: benefits of using plant-based chemicals to control weeds in agricultural areas
items.zh: 利用植物化学品控制农业地区的杂草的好处
items.why: 题干中的 benefits 对应第F段的两个好处: 一是降低农业除草成本，二是减少对合成化学品的依赖，更环保。

items.en: a description of the characteristics of allelopathic chemicals
items.zh: 对具有化感作用的化学物质的特性描述。
items.why: 题干中的 characteristics 对应第E段列举的一系列属性: 小剂量有效、选择性作用、干扰自然过程、无残留、可协同。

items.en: an example of a physical characteristic that helps one plant conserve water
items.zh: 有助于植物节水的物理特征实例
items.why: 题干关键词是 physical characteristic 和 conserve water。第A段中的 tightly rolled leaves 和 trichomes minimising water loss 都是帮助保存水分的物理特征。

items.en: The ‘hypodermic syringes’ of the nettle plant are an example of glandular trichomes.
items.zh: 荨麻身上像“皮下注射器”的结构是腺毛的一种。
items.why: 原文先介绍 glandular trichomes 腺毛，然后说荨麻中的 these trichomes 像微型注射器。题干说荨麻的“hypodermic syringes” = glandular trichomes 的例子，与原文一致。

items.en: Allelopathic plants grow more successfully than plants that rely only on physical features.
items.zh: 具有化感作用的植物，比只靠自身物理特征进行防御的植物长得更好。
items.why: 原文分别介绍物理防御和化感作用，没有比较只依靠物理特征的植物与化感植物哪一类生长得更好。

items.en: New research into synthetic herbicides is largely focused on individual allelopathic chemicals.
items.zh: 合成除草剂方面的新研究，主要集中在单种具有化感作用的化学物质上。
items.why: 题干说研究主要关注 individual allelopathic chemicals 单个化感化学物质，但原文强调的是two or more substances may combine 协同作用，即多个物质组合产生更强效果。题干与原文方向相反，所以是 FALSE。

items.en: Herbicides cost Australian farmers over A$200 million a year.
items.zh: 每年澳大利亚农民使用除草剂的成本超过2亿澳元。
items.why: 原文说的是 crop protection 作物保护总成本超过2亿澳元，其中至少一半用于 herbicides。也就是说除草剂成本至少超过1亿澳元，但不能推出“除草剂本身超过2亿澳元”。题干把总成本误读成除草剂成本，因此 FALSE。

items.en: The two main points of this article are that plants can defend themselves in a number of ways, and that
items.zh: 文章有两个主要观点：一个是植物有多种自卫方式，另一个是……
correct: chemicals found in weeds can have practical benefits for agriculture.
在杂草中发现的化学品可对农业产生实际好处。

points: 这是非常直接的定义句。题干中的 definition of the term allelopathy 对应原文 are known as 'allelopathy'。
原文说的是 crop protection 作物保护总成本超过2亿澳元，其中至少一半用于 herbicides。也就是说除草剂成本至少超过1亿澳元，但不能推出“除草剂本身超过2亿澳元”。题干把总成本误读成除草剂成本，因此 FALSE。
clauses: There are two major features of plants ….
“that ensure their continuation as species”修饰前面的 features。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 features，再把修饰信息接回主句。
As an example, recent research on the common thorn apple, Datura stramonium, a weed found throughout Australia, has found ….
“that two powerful chemicals are released from the seed during the early stages of germination”补足 found 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 found 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
lead: Professor John Lovett from New England University, Australia, describes some of the ways in which plants ensure their own survival.
澳大利亚新英格兰大学的John Lovett教授描述了植物如何确保自身生存。
